summary: Tenant-scoped text, opt-in photo/screenshot/video/audio feedback, selectable private media storage, triage and metadata-only evidence

implementation.storage: SQLite metadata schema1 plus additive attachment table; SQLite blobs or private filesystem media

ports.name: feedback.submit.v1
ports.idempotency: tenant+actor+key, canonical payload digest, original receipt replay

ports.name: feedback.storage.sqlite.v1
ports.effect: persistent customer feedback and optional audio bytes

ports.name: feedback.attachments.read.v1
ports.authority: tenant operator; corresponding media feature enabled
ports.effect: private bounded read with stored SHA256 integrity verification

limitations: Reference candidate; enterprise admission and managed hosting remain open
Browser screen capture requires explicit user selection in a supporting secure-context browser
MIME/signature screening is not decoding, malware scanning or automated redaction
SQLite and filesystem backups require a coordinated maintenance window; crash orphans need inspection
No PostgreSQL, S3, resumable large uploads, transcription or screenshot annotation implementation
No universal compatibility, distributed runtime or automatic private-variant migration qualification

rights.origin: new reference implementation; no customer source copied
rights.scope: this package only; repository-wide license unchanged

telemetry.privacy: metadata_only; no body/media/token/raw URL or filesystem root
